meta.name: stakeholder-mapping
meta.description: Prioritize stakeholders using two complementary grids. Use when setting engagement strategy and surfacing whose voice needs elevating after stakeholder identification.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用双网格矩阵排序利益相关者优先级
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目早期识别并排序关键利益相关者
copy.tagline_en: Prioritize stakeholders using two complementary grids
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify and prioritize key stakeholders early in a project

howto.what: 该技能会基于你提供的利益相关者名单，运行两个互补的2x2矩阵：权力×兴趣（决定如何互动）和影响×权力（发现谁受影响但缺乏话语权），然后对比结果，找出盲点并规划如何调整利益相关者的位置。
howto.when: 在完成利益相关者识别后，当你需要制定互动策略或发现哪些人的声音需要被提升时触发。

say.text: 帮我用两个矩阵分析这些利益相关者，列出名单。
say.note: 技能会要求你提供利益相关者名单。

say.text: 对比权力×兴趣和影响×权力的结果，找出盲点。
say.note: 技能会输出两个矩阵的对比分析。

howto.what_en: This skill runs two complementary 2x2 grids on your stakeholder list: Power × Interest (sets engagement strategy) and Impact × Power (surfaces who bears consequences but lacks voice). It compares outputs to reveal blind spots and plan quadrant migration.
howto.when_en: Trigger after stakeholder identification, when you need to set engagement strategy or surface whose voice needs elevating.

say_en.text: Analyze these stakeholders using both grids, here's the list.
say_en.note: Skill will ask for the stakeholder list.

say_en.text: Compare Power×Interest and Impact×Power results to find gaps.
say_en.note: Skill will output a comparison of the two grids.
